name: Baby Dots
tagline: Gentle moving dots to calm a young baby
description:
Baby Dots fills the screen with big, slowly drifting dots for a baby to watch. It is a sensory app made to calm and hold the attention of very young babies, who pick out large high-contrast shapes long before they see any detail.

Change the colour scheme from a single splash of colour to a full rainbow or plain monochrome, and set the size, speed and shape of the dots. Three calm classical pieces can play alongside them, or you can mute the sound. A sleep timer stops the music, dims the screen and turns it off when it runs out, and a child lock lets small fingers touch the dots to change them without dropping out of the app.

No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases. The paid copy on the Play Store is the same app and exists only so people can chip in.
